text: The Fed just hiked rates to 3.75%-4% with more increases signaled, GDP growth slowed to 1.5%, and inflation is stuck at 3.4% — this is a stagflationary setup where growth is weakening while borrowing costs keep rising, so tighten stops across the board and hold off on new risk.

IONQ is down 11% with negative earnings, 47% off its high, 10% short interest, and insiders selling — in a rising-rate environment, unprofitable speculative names get hit hardest, so reduce your exposure now.

MSTR is a leveraged Bitcoin bet with negative free cash flow and three earnings misses — with rates rising and liquidity tightening, trim this to a size where the volatility won't keep you up at night.

UNH trades at just 16.6x earnings with 12% revenue growth and strong free cash flow — this is a quality defensive compounder on sale at 10% off, and exactly the kind of name you want to own more of when the economy slows.

Visa is only 5% off its 52-week high with a reasonable PE of 24, 11% revenue growth, and proven resilience — adding here gives you a high-quality cash-flow machine that holds up well in uncertain markets.
Google at 22.6x earnings with 15% revenue growth is attractively valued for a megacap with that growth rate — use any flat or dip days to build this position while the price is reasonable.
